update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.43 - Quality breakdown and run history comparison in Discord notifications
Features --- - The end-of-career Discord embed now shows a breakdown of the parent quality score (epithets, fans, forced routes, race record, sparks, bonus) instead of just the total grade, so it's clear what drove the score. - Added a History field comparing the finished run against your archived run history: delta vs. session average and vs. your personal best fan count/quality score, or a "new best" callout when the run breaks your record.
